items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Russell and Illinois started out in Houston as a dance team; neither one of them could blow a horn. They danced. They had a dance team.

ctx.x: And I tell you how Illinois left. See, his dad worked for Southern Pacific railroad, and all the kids up to a certain age had passes to take vacations, and so this year Russell, his brother ...
